name: Carlos Writer
description: Proofread and rewrite selected text with a model on your own computer. Nothing goes to the internet unless you turn on the optional API.

cw-menu.description: Show the Carlos Writer menu for the selected text

cw-proofread.description: Proofread the selected text (fix errors only)

cw-carlos.description: Rewrite the selected text to sound like Carlos

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src http://localhost:11434 http://127.0.0.1:11434 https://api.anthropic.com
